name: [🎃] MERGE BRAINROT 💀
desc:
🧠 Merge brainrot together to create rarer ones! 🧠

Welcome to Merge Brainrot! Get ready to:

💥 Combine brainrots into bigger and better ones!
💎 Collect gems to power up faster!
🎨 Unlock trails and themes to stand out!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and compete for the top spot!
🐾 Unlock pets that earn you cash while you play!

Can you merge your way to the top of the brainrot chain?
